verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only shows bare marketing multipliers (e.g., 'Up to 2.2X the AI performance') and memory specs (288GB HBM3E, 8TB/s), with no published table of TFLOPS/TOPS broken out by precision (FP8/FP16/INT8/MXFP4/MXFP6) and sparse vs dense figures that an ML engineer could use to size training/inference. Community sources discuss comparative throughput qualitatively but don't supply the structured per-precision/sparsity numbers either.
